system_description.narrative_title: Trump–Xi Washington Summit: Pageantry, Modest Deals, Lingering Strategic Frictions
system_description.narrative_summary: The dominant narrative frames the Trump–Xi state visit as high‑profile spectacle with business and tech elites present, producing modest, headline agreements (an AI dialogue, tariff cuts and an extended trade truce) but few substantive resolutions of core strategic disputes. Key fault lines — Taiwan, Iran, rare‑earths, data/technology security, and supply‑chain ties — remain contested, prompting domestic criticism and sustained geopolitical uncertainty. The summit functions as an open system of diplomatic signaling, commercial access, and negotiations whose flows of goods, capital, information and political influence affect wider regional and global dynamics.
system_description.scope: Bilateral summit activities and immediate outcomes: state dinner and public pageantry; formal and behind‑the‑scenes meetings; announced trade measures (tariff cuts, extended truce) and AI dialogue; tech and corporate engagement; domestic political reactions; concurrent security tensions (Taiwan, South China Sea) and trade/supply‑chain vulnerabilities (rare earths, sanctioned firms, component flows).
system_description.super_system: The global geopolitical‑economic system: interstate diplomacy, international trade regimes, global technology governance, and security architectures centered on U.S.–China relations.
adjacent_subsystems: Global technology and AI governance (data centers, model competition, privacy/security)
Regional security in East and Southeast Asia (Taiwan, South China Sea, allied responses)
Global trade and supply chains (tariffs, rare‑earths, sanctions, manufacturing flows)
Domestic political economy and public opinion in the U.S. (Congress, parties, business lobby)

variables.name: Diplomatic signaling intensity
variables.description: Measures the frequency, prominence, and clarity of symbolic and verbal messages exchanged in high‑level diplomatic interactions.

variables.name: Summit pageantry level
variables.description: Measures the scale and visibility of ceremonial displays, public spectacles, and elite social engagement associated with top‑level meetings.

variables.name: Trade barrier level
variables.description: Measures the aggregate intensity of tariffs, quotas, and non‑tariff measures that impede cross‑border trade in goods and services.

variables.name: Trade truce stability
variables.description: Measures the durability, predictability, and likelihood of renewal of temporary agreements that pause or limit trade escalations.

variables.name: Technology governance alignment
variables.description: Measures the degree of policy convergence on standards, data governance, AI oversight, and cross‑border technology controls among major actors.

variables.name: Cross‑border data flow openness
variables.description: Measures the regulatory and technical ease with which personal, commercial, and research data move across jurisdictions.

variables.name: Supply‑chain vulnerability
variables.description: Measures susceptibility of critical supply networks to disruption due to concentration, chokepoints, single‑source dependence, or interdiction risk.

variables.name: Rare‑earths supply concentration
variables.description: Measures the concentration of extraction, processing, and export capacity for critical mineral inputs used in advanced technologies.

variables.name: Corporate diplomatic engagement
variables.description: Measures the intensity and visibility of private‑sector involvement in shaping, supporting, or participating in diplomatic interactions and economic diplomacy.

variables.name: Strategic tension level
variables.description: Measures the severity and salience of high‑level geopolitical frictions across core security fault lines, including contested territories and proxy activity.

variables.name: Military activity intensity
variables.description: Measures the tempo, scale, and proximity of deployments, patrols, exercises, and kinetic or non‑kinetic military operations in sensitive areas.

variables.name: Sanctions and export‑control intensity
variables.description: Measures the strictness, breadth, and enforcement intensity of trade restrictions, sanctions, and export controls on technology and goods.

variables.name: Domestic political backlash level
variables.description: Measures the intensity of domestic political opposition, criticism, and mobilization in response to external economic or diplomatic engagements.

variables.name: Capital flow volatility
variables.description: Measures short‑term variability in cross‑border investment, portfolio flows, and financing linked to policy, diplomatic, or market shocks.

variables.name: Supply‑chain interdependence
variables.description: Measures the degree of mutual reliance between economic systems for intermediate goods, components, and production inputs across value chains.

variables.name: Multilateral institutional clout
variables.description: Measures the authority, rule‑setting capacity, and practical effectiveness of multilateral norms and institutions in mediating disputes and coordinating policy.

catalysts.title: USTR to release trade negotiation details
catalysts.description: USTR Greer said details on U.S.-China trade negotiations will be released Monday, likely clarifying tariff cut scope and implementation steps.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Details on U.S.-China trade negotiations coming Monday, USTR Greer says' (2026-09-25).

catalysts.title: $30B tariff cuts rollout
catalysts.description: Implementation and application of the agreed $30 billion in tariff cuts during Xi's visit, affecting trade flows and certainty.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China, US agree to $30 billion tariff cut' and reporting that details will follow (2026-09-26, 09-25).

catalysts.title: Launch of US–China AI dialogue
catalysts.description: Bilateral AI dialogue agreed at the summit begins, creating a forum for tech governance talks and potential joint or parallel standards work.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China, US agree to AI dialogue, tariff cuts on $30 billion in goods' (2026-09-27).

catalysts.title: Trump says he'll meet Xi in China in November
catalysts.description: A planned presidential visit to China in November that would be a high-profile follow-up summit with ceremonial and policy implications.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Trump says he will meet Xi in China in November' (2026-09-25).

catalysts.title: Two additional Trump–Xi meetings
catalysts.description: Reported plans for two more meetings after Washington indicate an extended series of high-level engagements in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Trump and Xi to meet twice more after summit fails to resolve tensions' (2026-09-26).

catalysts.title: APEC/G20 co‑hosting coordination
catalysts.description: Agreement to support each other in hosting upcoming APEC and G20 meetings will trigger coordination and joint diplomacy at multilateral fora.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Trump and Xi agreed to support each other in hosting APEC, G20 summits, Xinhua reports' (2026-09-25).

catalysts.title: U.S. moves to bar Chinese datacenter tech
catalysts.description: Legislative and regulatory efforts aim to keep Chinese datacenter technology out of sensitive U.S. government systems, likely producing new restrictions.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US lawmakers aim to keep China's datacenter tech out of sensitive government systems' (2026-09-26).

catalysts.title: South China Sea resupply obstruction tensions
catalysts.description: Accusations of China obstructing resupply missions raise the likelihood of further maritime incidents and diplomatic-military responses in the region.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Philippines accuses China of obstructing resupply mission in South China Sea' (2026-09-25).

catalysts.title: Rare‑earths supply policy and market moves
catalysts.description: High attention to China's rare‑earths dominance may spur policy actions, supply diversification efforts, or export controls affecting concentration.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China's rare earths dominance to overshadow Trump's talks with Xi' (2026-09-25).
